policy.snapshot: byte-for-byte; load BotHost and BotBrain only; do not run the practice shell

round_lifecycle: Discard entire brain and construct a new BotBrain after native round_started scene replacement
state_isolation: Unique slot HOME, XDG data/config/cache/state/runtime, settings/save paths, cached token and native user:// session
logging: Discard PRACTICE_BOT_ policy traces; capture native stdout/stderr in per-slot rotating 2MiB logs with two backups; retain errors in stderr/journal; disable duplicate native file logging only in the generated bot project
